captions: Open Lobby
“Open Lobby” is a participatory project with refugees from “We are here” in
Amsterdam. For the Open Studios at the Jan van Eyck Academy in 2014, an office was
set up that allowed visitors to independently create dialogues on the refugee situation.
The dialogues were based on text fragments from public statements of various
personalities on different aspects of the refugee situation in the Netherlands.
The graphics of the exhibition as well as the logo were developed in cooperation with
the refugees. Press pictures of “Frontex” were used as visual material.
Postcards offering insight into several Dutch theme parks
which have been re purposed into refugee camps.
Welcome-Desk and Information-Wall of the Open Lobby at the Jan van Eyck academy.
Elke Uitenthuis researching legal documents concerned
with the refugee situation in the Netherlands
